description: This file declares functions related to JSON output for curl's writeout feature, specifically for generating JSON formatted data about transfer statistics and headers.

methods.name: jsonquoted
methods.description: Formats a string as a JSON string with optional lowercase encoding.

methods.name: ourWriteOutJSON
methods.description: Outputs transfer writeout data in JSON format to a stream.

methods.name: headerJSON
methods.description: Outputs HTTP headers as JSON to a stream.

methods.name: jsonWriteString
methods.description: Writes a string value in JSON format to a stream.
